headline: Smuggling undermines pulses and oilseeds exports, association warns
summary: The Ethiopian Pulses and Oilseeds Exporters Association warns that cross-border smuggling is undermining formal exports. It calls for stronger enforcement alongside investment in quality, processing and market development.
why: Pulses and oilseeds are agricultural commodities that Ethiopia exports, and smuggling diverts volumes and revenue from formal export channels that earn foreign currency.
